title: Mans Carpio: Personal money used for flagged purchases, not public funds

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Atty. Manases Carpio, the husband of Vice President Sara Duterte, said his flagged purchases were paid for with his personal funds and should not be attributed to public funds. Carpio made the statement after financial forensic analyst Atty. Alexander Cabrera, a witness for the House prosecution panel, flagged what he described as “unusual banking behavior” during Duterte’s impeachment trial on Friday. The transactions included credit card purchases by the couple at a discount store in Japan, Nike outlets in Malaysia and a Davao City mall.
